events_cancel_reason_consistent.name: events_cancel_reason_consistent
events_cancel_reason_consistent.value: "events"."cancel_reason" is null or ("events"."status" = 'cancelled' and length(trim("events"."cancel_reason")) between 1 and 300)

events_signups_close_before_start.name: events_signups_close_before_start
events_signups_close_before_start.value: "events"."signups_close_at" is null or "events"."starts_at" is null or "events"."signups_close_at" <= "events"."starts_at"

withdrawals_settlement_consistent.name: withdrawals_settlement_consistent
withdrawals_settlement_consistent.value: ("withdrawals"."status" = 'settled') = ("withdrawals"."settled_by" is not null and "withdrawals"."settled_at" is not null and "withdrawals"."settlement_note" is not null and length(btrim("withdrawals"."settlement_note")) > 0)
